input: Task: aws-move-products for the public repo (ai-first-markets, shift-roster-builder, real-estate-agent-photo-app docs, retail-pilot-intel docs, local-site-studio Convex); one PR per product; Grant Autopilot left to the private-repo session.

errors.what: my shift-roster pg test left a database granting entitlement_writer, which broke the starter's own e2e on the same server
errors.fix: the test now cleans up after itself

doc_friction.issue: 'a product is one module call in products.tf' conflicts with the brief's 'a product stack under stacks/<product>/' and the <stack>-* IAM naming; resolved by overriding platform.name_prefix per stack
its key is stacks/saas-starter/terraform.tfstate, the convention elsewhere is <stack>/terraform.tfstate; product stacks default saas_starter_state_key to the convention

deviations.why: shift-roster-builder had no Worker of ours to move (its hub runs on users' own machines); moving it meant building the hosted multi-team hub plus a per-team migration path, not porting a deployment
deviations.result: hosted hub tested in memory, on Postgres 16 and in Chromium

deviations.why: local-site-studio's Convex backend was never deployed, so the task's 'move it' had nothing to move; porting it is a launch decision
deviations.did: wrote the exception with scope and trigger

goal: North star: shift-roster's hosted hub is the first paid-shaped product on the AWS starter (paid gate dark)
notes: PRs (one per product, stacked in this order): 18787 shift-roster, 18792 listing-lens, 18794 retail-pilot-intel, 18795 ai-first-markets, 18796 local-site-studio exception + this record. Verified here (no AWS account; nothing applied): tofu 1.13.10 with hashicorp/aws 6.73.0 and archive 2.8.1 from a SHA256-checked filesystem mirror. tofu test: shift-roster 5, listing-lens 5, retail-pilot-intel 4, ai-first-markets 3, app-service 9, app-auth 2, dns 7, all pass; tofu fmt -check clean. saas-starter runtime node --test with Postgres 16: 15 pass (site.mjs gate, traversal, DB key). shift-roster: aws/app.test.mjs 7, aws/pg.test.mjs 1 (20 concurrent writes kept), console-browser.check.mjs in Chromium, run_venture_tests.py 794 tests 0 failed. site-browser.check.mjs in Chromium on the real listing-lens, retail-pilot-intel and ai-first-markets builds. ai-first-markets vitest 60 + tsc clean. Found and fixed: real-estate docs-site built every /docs/<slug>/ page as 'Page not found' (Next 16 params Promise). CI runners were queued most of the session.
